scientific_protocol_base.binding: Load the checksum-pinned Gemma protocol and apply only the exact JSON-pointer overrides below. Every other value, including inputs/order/directions, prompts, dynamic bounds, response contract, numeric decoding options, attempts, master seed and seed derivation, mechanical gates, first-pass selection, 60/60 release gate, blind questions/randomization seeds, and human thresholds, is byte-value identical after merge.

authorized_model_runtime_overrides./study_label: Post-final GPT-OSS controlled-editor comparison with author-blinded validation
authorized_model_runtime_overrides./runtime/official_source_description: Official Ollama OpenAI GPT-OSS 20B tag, 14 GB listing, 20.9B parameters, MXFP4
authorized_model_runtime_overrides./runtime/thinking_interface_note: GPT-OSS uses the Harmony reasoning interface. In non-project smoke, think=false returned empty final content; the official configurable low reasoning level returned the required structured final response. Reasoning text is never printed, retained, gated, selected, or exposed; only its character count and SHA-256 are recorded as runtime metadata.

/runtime/residency_control.before_run: ollama stop qwen3:14b, gemma4:12b, and gpt-oss:20b; then use one non-project explicit-tag warm-up and require ollama ps to contain exactly gpt-oss:20b with list ID 17052f91a42e
/runtime/residency_control.during_run: Every API request names gpt-oss:20b explicitly; every response model must equal gpt-oss:20b; /api/ps must contain exactly the pinned GPT-OSS tag and digest after warm-up and after generation.
/runtime/residency_control.after_run: ollama stop gpt-oss:20b and require ollama ps to be empty; do not remove GPT-OSS, Gemma, or Qwen.

authorized_model_runtime_overrides./blinded_review/review_id: 'GOE-' plus the first 12 RFC4648 base32 characters (without padding) of sha256(utf8(str(review_id_seed) + ':' + review_id_namespace + ':' + case_id))
authorized_model_runtime_overrides./blinded_review/answer_key: Private ignored CSV mapping review_id to case identity, hidden corpus/direction, original/candidate side, retained attempt, and exact text hashes; never reveal it until all 60 responses are frozen.

interface_controls.reasoning_text_policy: Never print, inspect, persist, select on, or pass to a gate; record only SHA-256 and character count.
interface_controls.unsupported_control_stop_rule: If any unchanged prompt, response schema, numeric option, seed, attempt, gate, or release/review rule cannot be honored, stop before project calls.
